definition: Sum of quantity x selling price of line items on completed reportable orders (after product markdowns; before coupons and refunds; GST-inclusive)
Gross revenue minus order-level coupon discounts minus processed return refunds (cancellation refunds excluded because cancelled orders are never in gross revenue)
Count of distinct completed (delivered/shipped/processing) reportable orders
Net revenue minus net COGS (COGS minus cost recovered from restockable returns)
Gross profit plus shipping fees collected minus shipping cost minus payment gateway fees minus marketplace commission (before marketing)
Contribution margin minus net marketing spend (only valid at date/channel/campaign grain)
Contribution margin / net revenue
(Gross revenue - coupon discounts) / completed orders excluding B2B bulk orders
Non-bot web/app sessions with a purchase event / non-bot web/app sessions (marketplace excluded - no session data)
Sessions with purchase / sessions that began checkout
Successful prepaid payment attempts / all prepaid payment attempts (COD excluded)
Processed return refunds / gross revenue - attributed to ORDER date (cohort basis) not refund date
Customers whose first completed reportable order falls in the period
Net acquisition marketing spend (excl. email/CRM) / new customers whose first order is attributed to a paid campaign
Net acquisition spend / all new customers (organic included) - flatters paid performance use with care
Net revenue of orders attributed to paid campaigns (last non-direct touch) / net marketing spend of those campaigns
Net revenue from web/app orders / non-bot sessions (no cross-device visitor id so session is the visitor proxy)
Share of new customers (mature cohorts only) who place a 2nd completed order within 90 days of the first
Customers of acquisition cohort with >=1 completed order in month N / cohort size
Customers active in prior 90 days who place no order in the next 90 days / active base (only for mature periods)
Cumulative contribution margin in first 180 days per acquired customer (cohorts with >=180 days of history only)
